_about: Sealed answer key for the receipts test. Truth for every receipt (all of receipts.csv plus the files, render hints and lines), the planted traps, the price watch and the 24-receipt ladder sample. Do not give this to a reader.

traps.what: The same docket photographed twice (two files). One receipt, one row.
traps.caught_when: exactly one row for the receipt, or a second row whose Note says it is a duplicate

traps.what: A refund docket: nappies returned unopened, money back to the card (bank row TG004, a credit).
traps.caught_when: the row is marked as a refund (negative total, or Note says refund) and its total is right

traps.what: Printed 22 Dec 2026, settled 24 Dec (T0866). A gift-card Woolworths shop the same morning has no bank row.
traps.caught_when: Date is the printed date, Entry ID is T0866, and the gift-card shop has no Entry ID

traps.what: Deli ham weighed in a container: gross 0.268 kg, tare 0.012 kg, net 0.256 kg charged.
traps.caught_when: the ham line has Qty 0.256 (net), not 0.268

traps.what: Rewards points redeemed for $10 off, printed as a line before the total; the card paid the rest.
traps.caught_when: the redemption is a negative line (-10.00) and Paid with is Card

traps.what: The printed total includes 3 reusable bags at $0.25.
traps.caught_when: a 0.75 bag line is kept, so the lines tie to the total

traps.what: ALDI docket photographed sideways, crumpled, with a smudge across the middle.
traps.caught_when: date and total exact and Entry ID right
